header.title: Menu
header.summary: {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} across {categories, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}}

card.hiddenHint: Not on the customer menu. Combos that include it still sell it.

notices.savedUntracked: Saved “{name}” — stock tracking is off, so the storefront will not mark it sold out.
notices.copied: Copied. The copy is hidden from customers, and option groups are not copied — add them in Edit, then switch on “Show on customer menu”.
notices.nowVisible: “{name}” is now on the customer menu.
notices.visibilityUnchanged: Nothing was changed. This dish may have been deleted, or your role may not be allowed to edit the menu at this branch.
notices.reloadFailed: Saved, but this list could not be reloaded. {reason}

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this menu item?
deleteConfirm.body: It disappears from the customer menu, and this cannot be undone.

editor.name: Name
editor.allergenPlaceholder: Type an allergen, press Enter (e.g. Peanuts)
editor.allergenHint: Shown to customers on the item page so allergy-sensitive diners can check before ordering.
editor.trackStockOnHint: The storefront marks this item sold out when the count reaches zero.
editor.trackStockOffHint: Not counted. The storefront will always offer this item.
editor.showOnMenuHint: Off takes the dish off the customer menu without deleting it (combos that include it still sell it). Copies start hidden, without option groups, so you can finish them first.
editor.stockReadFailed: Could not read this item’s stock settings. {reason}
editor.planLimit: You’ve reached your plan’s limit ({current} of {limit} items). Upgrade your subscription in Preferences → Plan & billing to add more.
editor.nothingSaved: Nothing was saved. This item may have been deleted, or your role may not be allowed to edit the menu at this branch.
editor.optionsWarning: “{name}” was saved, but one of its option groups could not be saved. {reason} Groups that did save were kept — reopen the item to finish its options.

modifiers.title: Options
modifiers.subtitle: Size, add-ons, prep choices customers pick

validation.groupName: Give every option group a name (e.g. Size) before saving.
validation.noOptions: Add at least one option to the “{group}” group, or remove the group.
validation.blankOptions: Name every option in “{group}”, or remove the blank ones.

removeConfirm.title: Remove this option group?
removeConfirm.body: It stops showing on this item, and is deleted entirely if no other item uses it.

reorder.unsavedHint: Unsaved changes — drag items between categories or up/down to reorder.
reorder.idleHint: Drag the handle to reorder categories and items.
reorder.emptyCategory: Drop items here to add to this category

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.permission: Your role isn’t allowed to edit the menu at this branch.
errors.notFound: This item no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
errors.inUse: It’s still linked to other records, such as past orders or combos, so it can’t be deleted. Hide it from the menu instead.
errors.invalidValue: Some values aren’t valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.fileTooLarge: That image is too large to upload.
errors.fileType: That file type can’t be uploaded. Choose an image file.
